title: Masking Personal Information
description:
Given a valid email address or phone number `s`, return its masked form. For emails, lowercase the name and domain, retain the first and last name letters, and replace the middle of the name with exactly five asterisks. For phone numbers, remove separators, keep the final four digits visible, and mask the other digits using the required country-code prefix format.

## Examples

```text
Input: s = "LeetCode@LeetCode.com"
Output: "l*****e@leetcode.com"
```

```text
Input: s = "1(234)567-890"
Output: "***-***-7890"
```

## Constraints

- `s` is either a valid email or phone number
- Email length is 8..40 and contains letters plus exactly one `@` and one `.`
- Phone length is 10..20 and contains digits plus the allowed `+ - ( )` and space separators
- Phone numbers contain 10..13 digits
